Key fact 1: 12笔应收与12笔银行入账金额逐笔相同 — supported by query results。BT-001至BT-007附言含发票号 — supported。BT-008至BT-012附言只有客户名加"货款" — supported。合计86,000元? BT-008..012 amounts: 2400000+1800000+1600000+1500000+1300000 = 8,600,000 minor = 86,000元. Yes. So supported.

Key fact 2: status=settled 会触发删除 collection_tasks 并向客户发出"已结清，余额0元"对账单. Manual says "核销采用数据库提交更新status=settled，事务提交即从collection_tasks移除，并通过账单通知服务向客户发出"已结清"对账单". But "余额0元" — the manual says "已结清"对账单, not "余额0元". Hmm, key fact says 发出"已结清，余额0元"对账单. The material only says "已结清"对账单. So the "余额0元" part isn't supported. Also deletion of collection_tasks — manual says "事务提交即从collection_tasks移除" — supported. Trigger mechanism: manual describes process but says 事务提交即...移除，即描述了行为。But whether it's "触发" by status update — the manual says the 核销 uses database update status=settled, transaction commit causes removal and notification. That's reasonably支持. But "余额0元" element missing. Strictly: 只支持其中一部分 → unsupported. I'll mark unsupported because 对账单内容"余额0元"没有依据。Hmm — but the fact says 发出"已结清，余额0元"对账单 — quote in manual is "已结清"对账单. The "余额0元" is an additional detail not in materials. So unsupported.

Actually let me consider: maybe "已结清" implies 余额0? 不能推断具体措辞。I'll mark unsupported with reasoning.

Key fact 3: manual 写明核销前应逐笔核对金额和附言发票号 — supported exactly: "核销前应逐笔核对金额和附言发票号".
